Plain A*B*C*D dot products (no phi-average, no K reduction).

==========================================================================================
MAPPING TO LOOP SEEDS  J_r(m,n)
Each phi-averaged  \bar{\mathcal{E}}^{lambda1 lambda2}_{sigma1 sigma2}  is expressed
as a linear combination of loop seeds
    J_r(m,n) = f_r(x - m/2 , x + n/2),   x = -i f \tilde\nu,
with f_0, f_c=f_1, f_cc=f_2, f_3, f_4 defined in the .tex.
sin(theta) eliminated via sin^2 = 1 - cos^2;  z = cos(theta).
J_3, J_4 are kept explicitly (NOT reduced to J_0).
This equals the dimensionless coefficient \mathcal{I}^{lambda1 lambda2}_{sigma1 sigma2;f}.
==========================================================================================
